brief.question: Rebuild the singleplayer mode of Cossacks 3 (C:\Games\Cossacks 3) as a playable Godot 4 game, matching the original's rules, controls, numbers and feel, using the original game's own assets.
brief.purpose: Port singleplayer mode to a new cross-platform Godot project for the person who owns the original game.
constraints: Use the original game's own files for the person's private use
brief.done_when: A Godot project in app/ that runs singleplayer, passes --screenshot and --self-test, and documents mechanics in MECHANICS.md/mechanics.json with original assets copied in.

plan.title: Read the game's own settings and scripts for singleplayer rules
plan.why: authoritative numbers: dmscript.global, unit.script, weapon.script, player.script, hotkeys.cfg, camera.cfg

plan.title: Decompile the game binary for the movement/fire/damage code
plan.why: the exe is packed; check whether any constants are readable

plan.title: Copy the original assets the port uses into the project folder
plan.why: textures, icons, sounds and maps must live with the project

plan.title: Finish the playable port: gather, mines, building, combat, AI, camera, controls
Add the fast command-line test mode and the screenshot option
plan.why: tests must never hang and must be quick

plan.title: Run the checks and compare against the original

hypotheses.claim: Game rules live in data/scripts not in cossacks.exe code because exe is packed Delphi stripped
hypotheses.prediction: native_strings_find for unit names returns 0, pseudocode shows loader only

findings.statement: World and movement constants come from dmscript.global: 26.6666666 px per meter, 53.3333333 px per tile, 32 fps, speeds 32/40/56/96/20 px/s.
Gathering and mine income confirmed: 22/14/20 hits for 45/28/40 loads, mine income 13*32/250=1.664 per s, upkeep consume/625 per s.
Damage formula is _misc_DoDamage in miscext2.script: minus 5 vs fast horse, minus shield, minus squad bonus, minus protection, minimum 1.
cossacks.exe entry at 0x8f1a08 is a packed loader showing Cossacks III title and DEP/single-instance messages; game logic is not in static code.
